sections.description: GeneratePress ecosystem abilities for MCP. Theme settings, GP Premium module status, GP Elements (full CRUD), GenerateBlocks settings, global styles (full CRUD) and Pro pattern libraries. Components are detected at runtime; abilities of missing components are simply not registered.
sections.changelog:
1.3.8

  • Fixed: update-module-setting with group "page_header" wrote to GP Premium's legacy generate_page_header_options instead of the canonical generate_page_header_settings the Customizer and front end actually read — the write reported success but changed nothing.
  • GP Elements gained block_type, the sub-type that decides which theme hook a "block" element renders on. A block element created without it is stored but never rendered, so this closes a real hole in create/update/get-gp-element rather than adding a new verb.
  • GP Elements gained layout_settings for "layout" elements: sidebar_layout, footer_widgets, content_area, content_width and the eight disable_* toggles, following GP Premium's own save contract (clearing a value removes the override so the element inherits the site default again).
  • font_library is now in the module map, so get-status reports it and toggle-gp-module accepts it. Managing the font files themselves remains out of scope.
  • Passing block_type on a non-block element, or layout_settings on a non-layout one, is now refused with a clear error instead of being silently ignored.

1.3.7

  • Fixes stale GenerateBlocks CSS after an API write: GP Element writes (create/update/status/delete) and update-gb-setting now automatically clear GenerateBlocks' server-side dynamic CSS cache. GP Premium's own cache invalidation for elements lives behind a classic-editor nonce a programmatic write never sends, so before this an element added via the API (e.g. a header icon) could render with stale/missing CSS until regenerate-gb-css was called manually.
  • Normal post/page content writes were already handled by GenerateBlocks core, and global-style writes by GenerateBlocks Pro, so those paths are deliberately left untouched (no redundant full-cache wipes).

1.3.6

  • New ability: replace-gb-media — swaps which image a generateblocks/media block (identified by its uniqueId) points to, updating its JSON attributes (mediaId, htmlAttributes.src/alt/title) and its rendered img tag together via parse_blocks()/serialize_blocks() so the two never disagree. Also usable to repair an already-desynced block. 39 -> 40 abilities.
  • Registers a callback on wp-core-mcp's new wp_core_mcp_pre_content_write filter: refuses a patch-post/update-post write that would leave a generateblocks/media block's JSON attributes and rendered HTML disagreeing (e.g. an edit that changed only the visible src), naming the exact block/attribute/values in the error.

1.3.5

  • Fixed the MCP Adapter's execute-ability tool masking schema errors as a generic "Permission denied": get-post-layout and update-post-layout now accept id (preferred) alongside post_id (deprecated alias, kept for backward compatibility). 8 permission callbacks across GP Elements and GB global styles now return a clear WP_Error when the expected id parameter is missing or invalid, instead of silently defaulting to 0.

1.3.4

  • Security audit: SENSITIVE_PATTERN's bare auth substring was matching author/author_id field names, causing unnecessary over-redaction. Narrowed to authoriz — still catches authorization/authorized, no longer catches author.

1.3.3

  • CRITICAL: fixed a data-corruption bug — GP Element and GB global style content was not wp_slash()-ed before being passed to wp_insert_post()/wp_update_post()/update_post_meta(), causing WordPress's own unslash step to strip literal backslashes (e.g. JSON-escaped characters inside Gutenberg block attributes like globalClasses, corrupting block validation and generated CSS). Fixed across GP Elements and GB global styles. Theme settings/mods were verified safe and left untouched.

1.3.1

  • Initial public release: 39 abilities covering theme settings, theme mods, GP Premium module status, GP Elements CRUD, GenerateBlocks settings, global styles CRUD and pattern libraries.
